characters.description: An immensely powerful sorcerer from Skulduggery's past whose preserved heart is the focus of the Anti-Sanctuary's work. Her followers believe restoring her body will give their movement the leader it needs.
characters.name: Abyssinia

recaps.ending: Valkyrie and her allies break Smoke's influence over Skulduggery and recover him, but they cannot stop the larger operation. The healer Melior is forced to use his ability on Abyssinia's preserved heart, rebuilding the body of the long-dead sorcerer. Abyssinia awakens and the surviving members of the Anti-Sanctuary withdraw with their restored leader, turning what first appeared to be a scattered conspiracy into a continuing threat. Valkyrie survives her return to the field and chooses not to retreat to her isolated life in America; she resumes working with Skulduggery while still carrying the trauma and guilt that brought her home in such a fragile state. Omen, having proved useful and brave despite his lack of status, remains part of their informal network. Elsewhere, Sebastian Tao continues the separate project of gathering people who want to bring Darquesse back.
recaps.in_short: Five years after Darquesse's defeat, Valkyrie Cain returns from self-imposed exile in America, burdened by guilt and trauma. Skulduggery draws her into an investigation of the Anti-Sanctuary, while overlooked Corrival Academy student Omen Darkly becomes an unlikely source inside the school. The conspirators include Lethe, Razzia, Cadaverous Gant, and Smoke, whose magic strips away inhibitions and turns Skulduggery against his allies. Valkyrie helps free him from that influence, but the heroes discover too late that the group's real objective is the restoration of Abyssinia, a powerful figure from Skulduggery's past. The healer Melior is coerced into rebuilding her from her preserved heart. Abyssinia returns to life and escapes with her followers. Valkyrie elects to remain beside Skulduggery, and Omen earns a place in their continuing work, as the revived Abyssinia becomes the central threat ahead.

recaps.text: Five years have passed since the battle in which Darquesse was removed from Valkyrie Cain and sent away, ending the immediate threat she posed to the world. The victory did not restore Valkyrie's old life. She withdrew to the United States, separated herself from Skulduggery and most of her friends, and has lived with guilt, depression, and recurring memories of the harm done through her. Skulduggery remains a Sanctuary detective in Ireland, where China Sorrows now leads the sorcerer government from Roarhaven. Valkyrie's younger sister Alice is alive and growing up, but Valkyrie remains deeply troubled by what happened to her family during the Darquesse crisis.

Valkyrie returns to Ireland after five years away and finds that neither contact with her family nor a reunion with Skulduggery can erase the damage she carries. Skulduggery is investigating a new pattern of violence around the Sanctuary and persuades her to help, initially on a limited basis. At Corrival Academy, Omen Darkly lives in the shadow of his brother Auger, the celebrated Chosen One. Because Omen attracts little attention, he is well placed to notice tensions and secret allegiances among the students. Skulduggery begins using him as an inside source, giving Omen a dangerous responsibility for which neither his family nor his classmates consider him suited.

The investigation points to the Anti-Sanctuary, a group that rejects China's government and is building a network inside and outside Roarhaven. Its field operatives include the masked fighter Lethe and several Neoterics whose unusual powers do not fit the older magical disciplines. Omen's work at Corrival Academy ties part of the conspiracy to young sorcerers, placing him and his friends in increasing danger. Valkyrie struggles to function through panic and exhaustion but continues beside Skulduggery. The pair learn that the enemy is collecting people and abilities for a coordinated purpose rather than carrying out isolated attacks.

Smoke, one of the Anti-Sanctuary's Neoterics, can loosen the moral restraints that keep a person's darker impulses in check. His power is used on Skulduggery, turning the detective's ruthlessness against Valkyrie and the Sanctuary. Valkyrie is forced to oppose the partner she has only just regained while trying to reach the part of him that Smoke has suppressed. Omen continues to pass information from inside Corrival Academy and is pulled beyond observation into direct danger. The conspiracy's interest in the healer Melior and Lethe's fierce concern for him reveal that the operation depends on an act of healing far beyond ordinary treatment.

Valkyrie's allies close in on the Anti-Sanctuary and break Smoke's control over Skulduggery, restoring him to himself. They uncover the group's central object: the preserved heart of Abyssinia, an exceptionally powerful sorcerer connected to Skulduggery's violent past. Melior has been coerced into using his healing discipline not merely to mend a wound but to reconstruct a body around the heart. Personal loyalties within the conspiracy begin to fracture under the pressure, but the heroes arrive without a reliable way to reverse a resurrection once it has begun.

Skulduggery is freed from Smoke's influence and rejoins Valkyrie, but stopping him has cost the allies the time they needed. Melior completes the coerced healing, and Abyssinia is restored to a living body. The remaining Anti-Sanctuary members escape with the leader for whom their campaign was designed, leaving China and the detectives facing an organized new enemy rather than a defeated cell. Valkyrie does not return to her former isolation in America. Still traumatized and far from recovered, she chooses to continue working with Skulduggery. Omen survives his first involvement in their world and has demonstrated that being overlooked does not make him useless. Sebastian Tao's separate effort to bring back Darquesse also continues in secret.

characters.description: An Earth teacher whose memories survive a disrupted reincarnation. He awakens in the recently dead body of Magus Vermil with fragments of its former owner's knowledge, a book of runes, and a dangerous need to understand his new magic.
characters.name: Noah Vines

characters.description: The deity who selects Noah for reincarnation after his death. Her attempt to send him into a new life is disrupted when a many-voiced black entity attacks the place where souls await renewal.
characters.name: Renewal

characters.description: A rank-one student assigned to Vermil's neglected class. He arrives late because the professor normally does not teach and is startled to find a real lesson beginning.
characters.name: Todd

characters.description: A blue-haired rank-one student in Vermil's class. Like Todd, she expects an absent and unhelpful professor, so Vermil's sudden insistence on teaching immediately puts her on guard.
characters.name: Isabel

characters.description: An Arbitage magus who encounters Vermil while he searches the library for rune-combination material. She knows his prior reputation and openly regards him as a disgrace to the Linwick family.
characters.name: Moxie

characters.description: The operator of Arbitage's transport cannon. He manages fixed-duration journeys to places such as the Scorched Acres and is responsible for retrieving travelers when their allotted window ends.
characters.name: Tim

characters.description: A monster found near Arbitage whose master rune has pushed it close to the third rank. Moxie tells Noah that the rank-two creature is far beyond his ability to fight.
characters.name: Hellreaver

characters.description: A senior magus with a runework silver right leg and responsibility for Tyler's instruction. He interrupts Noah's reflexive attack on his apprentice and interprets it as the reaction of someone conditioned by combat.
characters.name: Magus Silvertide

characters.description: Moxie's noble student, equipped with family-provided runes and an education that extends beyond combat. Moxie initially allows Noah to observe her lessons only on the condition that he not interact with Emily.
characters.name: Emily

characters.description: A member of the Linwick family who threatens Isabel in the Arbitage library. He relies on runed clothing and a shield for protection, but Noah bypasses those defenses with a physical feint and breaks his nose.
characters.name: Edward

characters.description: A second man with Vermil's exact appearance, discovered standing beside Todd after mutilated monsters are found in the Scorched Acres. His identity and purpose are not yet known.
characters.name: Duplicate Vermil

characters.description: Edward's rank-four professor and mentor. He waits at Arbitage with Edward after Noah's confrontation with the younger Linwick, prepared to pursue his student's grievance.
characters.name: Allen

characters.description: The apparent skinwalker who took the body Noah lost in the Scorched Acres and appeared as a duplicate Vermil. After explaining that the body was consumed and memorized, the creature asks Noah for a name and chooses Lee from his suggestion.
characters.name: Lee

characters.description: An Arbitage enforcer investigating the Hellreaver's death and the disappearance of its master rune. Neir questions Noah at the transport cannon but accepts Tim's assessment that a rank-one professor could not have killed the monster alone.
characters.name: Neir

characters.description: Vermil's elder brother and a Linwick investigator. He arrives on official family business, blocks outside listening, and demands to know why Vermil survived a task that was expected to end with his apparent death.
characters.name: Brayden

characters.description: A senior authority in Moxie's noble house who manifests through plant magic to receive a secret report. Magus Evergreen orders Moxie to exploit her new Linwick connection while continuing to keep Emily safe.
characters.name: Magus Evergreen

characters.description: An Arbalest Empire soldier encountered during an active root-fiend hunt. He fights in heavily inscribed armor, flies, and channels powerful magic through a hammer while warning the nearby travelers about the monster.
characters.name: Gavin

characters.description: Gavin's soldier partner and a specialist in rune research and imbuement. She arrives by portal and explains that her work powers Gavin's armor and weapon, with designs that draw much of their energy from the environment.
characters.name: Jess

recaps.ending: Noah reaches Linwick city as a rank-two mage with Sunder, the Hellreaver's Combustion master rune, and a perfected pyroclastic resonance rune. Lee remains beside him as a willing ally rather than a bound servant. Todd and Isabel have passed their first examination and developed into capable fighters, though Todd's unusual knowledge of body imbuement and Isabel's exhausting secret training remain unexplained. Brayden continues to protect the claim that Vermil could not have killed the Hellreaver and escorts Noah, Lee, Todd, Isabel, Allen, and Edward into Linwick territory. Moxie and Emily separate from the party before the border because of hostility between Moxie's house and the Linwicks; they plan to train and reunite with the others in two weeks. Noah intends to face Vermil and Brayden's father using a controlled-demon explanation for his changed identity. The poisoner, Father's exact plan, the intended outcome of Vermil's summoning, and the possible escape of a stronger demon all remain unresolved.
recaps.in_short: After dying on Earth, teacher Noah Vines awakens in the poisoned body of the disreputable Magus Vermil and discovers that the master rune Sunder binds his resurrection to a gourd. At Arbitage, he uses Vermil's identity to learn magic while genuinely training neglected students Todd and Isabel. An apparent skinwalker named Lee becomes his ally and is later revealed as a lesser demon released by Vermil's failed summoning. Noah kills the Hellreaver, inherits its Combustion rune, reaches rank two, and uses Sunder to perfect a pyroclastic resonance rune. The kill brings an Arbitage investigation, while Vermil's brother Brayden reveals that their father expected a demon-related assignment to alter Vermil's fate. Noah travels toward Linwick territory with his students, Lee, Brayden, Allen, and Edward. Moxie and Emily remain outside the territory to train. The book ends at the gates of Linwick city, where Noah intends to confront Vermil's father and uncover the unfinished summoning plan.

recaps.text: Earth teacher Noah Vines dies and is selected for reincarnation by Renewal, but a many-voiced black entity attacks during the process. Noah retains his memories and awakens in the recently dead body of Magus Vermil, who appears to have been poisoned by a supposed healing potion. After a monster kills him in the Scorched Acres, Noah repeatedly reforms beside Vermil's gourd. He confirms that the vessel anchors his return and learns that killing monsters restores energy. Rescuers take him to Arbitage, where he claims memory loss and assumes Vermil's identity. Vermil was a protected but disreputable rank-one professor who rarely taught and mistreated students. Noah chooses teaching as both cover and a route to understanding magic. His only students, Todd and Isabel, initially expect the old arrangement of neglect and corruption, but respond to Noah's first-principles lesson. They explain rune slots and advancement. Examining Vermil's soul, Noah finds seven ordinary runes and an anomalous eighth rune called Sunder, apparently connected to the force that disrupted his reincarnation.

Noah learns that monster kills charge individual runes and begins rebuilding Vermil's weak set around wind, ash, and vibration. Moxie, a hostile magus who knew Vermil, gives him basic rune information after a skinwalker incident leaves Noah with leverage over her. Todd and Isabel reveal that Vermil normally took payment to falsify their examination, which requires each student to kill a slasher. Noah instead offers a month of real training. Their fire and sword abilities are promising, but both rely on slow, costly shields and initially freeze against live monsters. Noah studies monster patterns through dangerous hunts and repeated deaths, discovering that every death leaves accumulating damage in his mind or soul. His demonstrations help the students understand that slashers can be predicted, and both begin defeating smaller monsters without shields. During a later training trip, a rock-throwing Chucker gravely wounds Noah. Under pressure, he discovers that ash magic can shape the burned surroundings into lethal spikes. He kills the monster, dies, and returns to his gourd, only to find that the body he left behind has vanished.

Noah reunites with Todd and Isabel and continues preparing them for the exam while investigating the cost of his resurrection. Damage from repeated deaths causes hallucinations and a reflexive attack on Tyler, but the condition recedes as Noah avoids dying and his soul heals. He secretly shares Vermil's greater-rune book with his students, allowing Todd to copy a greater fire rune and Isabel a greater stone rune. They replace weaker runes and learn to kill slashers as a coordinated team. Noah buys a cheap flying sword, develops vibration magic, and hunts stronger monsters to build energy and income. Moxie's lessons show him how much access noble students receive compared with Todd and Isabel. During a large vibration test in the Scorched Acres, Noah uproots trees and empties his vibration rune. He then discovers a huge burning ape within a contained ring of fire. Sunder reacts to it, identifying the creature as the Hellreaver. When it opens its eyes, Noah recognizes the same gaze he saw inside the damaged region of his mind. He is trapped inside the ring with much of his equipment outside and his strongest tested rune depleted.

The Hellreaver kills Noah, but he delays his return long enough to memorize its location. Back at Arbitage, Noah finds Edward threatening Isabel and breaks the Linwick student's nose. Tim warns that someone may be tracking Noah's regular travel pattern. While Todd and Isabel approach exam readiness, the missing corpse reappears as a second Vermil standing beside Todd. The duplicate is an apparent skinwalker that knows Noah returns from death. Noah protects his secret by calling it a clone, then accepts a reciprocal rune oath that prevents the creature from exposing his revivals or attacking unprovoked humans. Edward's mentor, Allen, responds to the library incident by arranging an exam contest between Edward and Isabel, with a greater rune at stake. The apparent skinwalker takes the name Lee and agrees to watch for sabotage. During the exam, Todd passes by killing a slasher. Allen delays Isabel, and Edward attacks her while she engages another monster, but Lee secretly moves her to safety. Isabel passes and gains more kills than Edward. Allen honors the wager, allowing her to take a rune page from his grimoire. Both Todd and Isabel officially pass.

Moxie concludes that Noah is not the original Vermil and learns that the body's former owner was poisoned, though Noah keeps Sunder and his full history secret. She agrees to exchange information and let Emily join Noah's expanded class. Noah attacks the Hellreaver again and dies, then learns from Lee that master runes are unique powers with inverse passive effects. He identifies Sunder as the source of the binding that returns him to the gourd. Lee enters Arbitage as an unofficial physical-combat instructor and demonstrates exceptional speed, flexibility, and body imbuement. Moxie accepts the arrangement, and the class begins preparing for a later three-day survival examination. Seeking stronger wind runes, Noah travels to Windscorned Plateau with rune-collecting paper. The local woolly monsters resist his wind and vibration attacks. Noah calls a small amount of Sunder for the first time, bisecting one creature but suffering severe internal damage and another death. After further training with Lee, he returns to the plateau and successfully captures a greater wind rune. He now has the resource needed to upgrade his magic and renew his attempt to kill the Hellreaver.

Noah converts his remaining weak wind runes into greater ones and returns to the Scorched Acres. The Hellreaver proves able to burn away ash and remove the air, preventing both breathing and wind magic. Lee follows and challenges Noah's willingness to treat his deaths as expendable. After several failed attacks, Noah prepares Sunder before entering the fight, uses ash to remain mobile without air, and reaches the monster despite another mental assault. Sunder decapitates the Hellreaver. Its falling body kills Noah, while the victory fills his runes enough for rank two and triggers a beacon. Lee removes Noah's nameplate before investigators arrive. Arbitage concludes that a group killed the monster and stole its master rune, and enforcer Neir orders Noah not to leave the academy, although Tim convinces him that rank-one Vermil could not be responsible. Noah discovers that he inherited the Hellreaver's fire-producing master rune and its air-stilling passive. Brayden then arrives as Vermil's elder brother and asks why Vermil survived a family task. Noah privately admits the Hellreaver kill to Moxie under a narrow oath, while the hidden Linwick assignment becomes the next immediate danger.

Moxie supplies a Linwick family reference and promises to care for Todd and Isabel if Noah cannot continue. Noah uses Lee and alcohol to question Brayden without remaining impaired, learning that their father tied Vermil's task to a long-planned summoning and an election meant to elevate their family branch. The intended result of Vermil's apparent death remains unclear. Lee then reveals that she is a rank-three lesser demon, not a skinwalker. Vermil's flawed summoning bound arrivals to his will and trapped them in the Scorched Acres, while Noah's command accidentally freed her. She stayed from loyalty and believes the stronger demon Vermil intended to summon may also have escaped. Noah decides to approach the Linwicks while posing as a demon contained in Vermil's body. Todd and Isabel learn about the Hellreaver and the possible demon threat, then consider joining the journey voluntarily. Preparing for the trip, Noah combines two wind, two ash, and three vibration runes. The result is an imperfect rank-two pyroclastic resonance rune that controls sound, heat, smoke, and air-related effects. He has finally advanced, but plans to use Sunder to improve the combination.

Noah confirms that Sunder can split a completed rune combination back into its seven components without destroying them. By storing runes in his grimoire, he gains a unique way to test and revise combinations. Moxie discovers Lee's demonic nature and tries to have her killed, forcing Noah to defeat and restrain Moxie without lethal force. After speaking privately with Lee, Moxie accepts that Lee's conduct contradicts the danger she expected and apologizes. Lee promises not to harm the students, and the two agree to rebuild trust. Todd and Isabel choose to accompany Noah toward Linwick territory, while Moxie and Emily join for the part of the route they can safely travel. Noah deceives Brayden into believing the Hellreaver is contained within him and asks to meet their father. Allen and Edward unexpectedly join the party, preserving the hostility created by the exam dispute. During the overland journey, Lee begins teaching gradual body imbuement. Moxie secretly reports to Magus Evergreen, a senior authority in her house. Evergreen orders her to exploit the Linwick connection and reminds her that protecting Emily and serving the house take priority over teaching or personal loyalty.

The traveling party continues training while crossing monster territory. Noah studies local snufflers, blind burrowers that track movement through the ground, and uses them as supervised opponents. Todd displays effective but painful fire-based body imbuement, Emily defeats one with an ice and water bow, and Isabel develops reinforced stone armor and weapons while secretly practicing alone. Lee covertly protects Isabel from a more dangerous aerial monster. The group then encounters Gavin, an Arbalest Empire soldier fighting a root fiend with heavily imbued equipment. His partner Jess arrives by portal and explains that her environmental-energy imbuements power much of his gear. When two more root fiends awaken, Gavin and Jess take one while Noah's party holds the other. Brayden shields the students from underground roots, Allen restrains the creature with ice, and Moxie binds it with vines. Noah fills its body with ash and smoke, then uses the Hellreaver's Combustion rune to destroy it from within. Gavin and Jess kill the other fiend. They acknowledge the danger their operation caused, offer Noah possible future help, and depart as the party resumes its journey.

At a village stop, Moxie explains that professors are mentors and researchers rather than merely combat instructors. She also describes rank-four domains and the longer lives available at higher ranks. Noah realizes that Sunder might eventually help both Moxie and Lee overcome dangerous advancement barriers, but keeps that possibility secret until the Linwick confrontation is resolved. He learns how noble control and counterfeit sales restrict access to reliable runes, and how badly unbalanced combinations can damage a mage's body. Noah begins imbuing pyroclastic resonance into his lungs and places Combustion into his soul, developing controlled fire-breath, inert air near his skin, and explosive attacks delivered through smoke. Todd's unexpectedly fluent advice about body imbuement makes Noah suspect the student has concealed part of his experience. Before the group crosses the Deadlands, Noah uses Sunder to dismantle his partly filled rank-two rune while preserving its energy. He rebuilds pyroclastic resonance from three vibration, three wind, and one ash rune. The redesigned combination is perfect, expands his soul, and leaves him with a stronger foundation for later magic.

The party enters the Deadlands, where a pale worm drags Brayden underground. Moxie and Isabel defend the group while Todd's fire and Allen's ice prove ineffective against it. Brayden kills the creature from inside by striking its three hearts, and everyone survives. After leaving the Deadlands, Noah completes a cleaner pyroclastic resonance imbuement on his lungs, improving its coordination with Combustion. Isabel grows increasingly exhausted and repeatedly disappears from her tent at night, which Noah suspects is secret training. At the edge of Linwick territory, Moxie and Emily separate from the others because Moxie's house is hostile to the Linwicks. They will train for the survival exam and meet the party again in two weeks. Brayden leads Noah, Lee, Todd, Isabel, Allen, and Edward to the walled Linwick city. Noah arrives as a rank-two mage with Sunder, Combustion, and a perfected pyroclastic resonance rune. He intends to confront Vermil and Brayden's father using a controlled-demon cover, secure Vermil's standing, and uncover the unfinished summoning plan. The poisoner, the stronger escaped demon, and Father's exact purpose remain unresolved.

characters.description: An Arbitage professor traveling under Vermil's identity with his students as he enters unsettled Linwick territory. Noah is protective of his pupils and wary of the noble family's internal struggle.
characters.name: Noah Vines

characters.description: Noah's close traveling companion, who accompanies him into Linwick territory with Todd and Isabel.
characters.name: Lee

characters.description: One of Noah's students, traveling with him into Linwick territory. Todd trains alongside Isabel and faces the disadvantages imposed on students without noble backing.
characters.name: Todd

characters.description: One of Noah's students and Todd's close training partner. Isabel enters Linwick territory with Noah's group.
characters.name: Isabel

characters.description: Vermil's elder brother and the group's Linwick escort. He brings Vermil before the family head.
characters.name: Brayden

characters.description: A rank-five member of a Linwick side branch who has returned from a long excursion and gathered support to challenge the family head. His rise makes the estate politically unstable.
characters.name: Dayton

characters.description: The calculating head of Vermil and Brayden's Linwick branch. He seeks proof that a demon occupies Vermil's body and discusses terms for possible cooperation.
characters.name: Father

characters.description: A fearful offshoot Linwick rune researcher ordered to answer Noah's questions about the family and its rivals.
characters.name: Janice

characters.description: An Arbitage magus who keeps Noah alive during his coma and safeguards his belongings while he recovers from grave injuries.
characters.name: Moxie

characters.description: Moxie's noble student, training with Todd and Isabel while Noah recovers.
characters.name: Emily

characters.description: A rank-three inquisitor who confronts Noah's group, claims a demon is among them, and confines them with anti-demon magic.
characters.name: Johan

characters.name: Revin

characters.name: James

recaps.ending: Todd, Isabel, Emily, and James pass the Snowfield survival exam after revealing that they reached rank two during their training. Eline fails, but Revin spares her and makes her his shadow-bound trainee, with freedom possible only after she grows strong enough. The real Magus Evergreen accepts Emily's result and gives Moxie two months away from tutoring. Noah, Moxie, and Lee plan to spend that break together, while the students separate for further training. Noah is now rank three and can use Fragment of Renewal to repair some of Lee's soul damage, but Azel remains contained inside his soul. The unknown force behind the exam sabotage and the hijacked Evergreen replica is still active. Renewal is searching for Noah, the Church of Repose has entered the Empire, and the Linwick plot, Karina's obligations, and Todd and Isabel's family grievances all remain unresolved.
recaps.in_short: Noah enters Linwick territory under Vermil's identity, deceives the family head into believing a demon controls Vermil's body, and drives Dayton away while learning more about the destruction of Todd and Isabel's families. After surviving an arranged inquisitor attack, he returns to Arbitage and takes Todd, Isabel, and Emily through intensive wilderness training with Moxie and Lee. Noah reaches rank three, creates Fragment of Renewal, and begins healing Lee's damaged soul, but this draws Renewal's attention and restores Azel, a rank-five demon bound inside him. At the final survival exam, an Evergreen replica is exposed as the tool of an unknown saboteur. Todd, Isabel, Emily, and James reveal their rank-two advancement, take Eline's tokens, and pass. Revin makes the defeated Eline his bound trainee, while Moxie receives a two-month leave and joins Noah and Lee for the break.

recaps.text: Previously: Noah Vines awoke in the body of the dead magus Vermil and continued using Vermil's identity at Arbitage. As a professor, he took responsibility for Todd and Isabel, students disadvantaged by the academy's noble hierarchy. His unusual return from death and the rune Sunder let him dismantle and recombine runes in ways other mages could not. Lee became his close companion and co-operator, while Moxie emerged as a trusted fellow professor. Noah's conflicts at Arbitage included the death of a Hellreaver, an event that left official attention focused on Vermil. By the start of this volume, Noah's true identity, his repeated revivals, and Lee's nature all remain secrets that could endanger the group.

Noah enters the Linwick estate with Brayden, Lee, Todd, and Isabel while Dayton challenges the local family head. In private, Noah tells Father that Vermil died during a demon summoning and that a demon called Spider now uses his body. Lee copies Noah's form, and Noah allows Father to kill him before returning in a replacement body, making the multiple-body deception credible. Father grants limited rune information but continues testing the supposed demon with poison and surveillance. Todd and Isabel each receive an armor rune, then secretly watch Dayton because of harm he caused their families. Lee rescues them from Dayton's guard. Father subsequently commissions Spider to make Dayton flee or die without implicating the Linwick branch. Noah accepts, both to gain knowledge and to keep Father from destroying Dayton's entire household.

Noah intimidates Dayton through staged deaths, impossible returns, and Lee's public impersonation of him. Dayton concludes that an immortal demon serves Magus Evergreen and surrenders his grimoire before fleeing the estate. Father accepts the result while continuing to investigate Noah's weakness. From the stolen material, Noah uses Sunder to create Focal Quake and retains several valuable runes connected to Evergreen. Todd and Isabel then explain their shared history. Their allied noble families were destroyed after Isabel's father found a master rune and refused to surrender it. Their parents were killed, the surviving children lost the right to use their surnames, and the missing master rune was never recovered. Dayton was among those who pursued Isabel's father, confirming why both students want eventual revenge.

Father secretly arranges for inquisitors to kill Noah’s party on the road back to Arbitage. Johan traps Noah, Lee, Todd, and Isabel with anti-demon magic while Inaros intercepts Brayden. The students defend Noah and Lee, and the separated fights become deadly. Johan kills Noah, but Noah briefly pulls his soul back into his body and kills Johan before dying again. Brayden drives Inaros away, and Noah later regenerates from his gourd. Lee then explains that she is the source of Noah’s supposed duplicate bodies. Brayden, Todd, and Isabel learn enough of the truth to understand that the person they know is not the original Vermil and can revive after death. The group survives and returns toward Arbitage, but Father’s involvement in the attack cannot yet be proved, and the official inquiry into the Hellreaver remains another danger to Noah’s cover.

Noah spends weeks unconscious after the inquisitor attack while Moxie guards him and trains the students with Lee. A failed rune-forming attempt unexpectedly restores Noah's damaged soul and draws the attention of immense powers searching for mortals touched by the divine. Soon after waking, Noah confronts Contessa, a Torrin operative controlling Moxie. He binds Contessa to secrecy, forces her to report through Moxie, and tells Moxie that Vermil is dead and Noah occupies his body. He also reveals that Sunder lets him break down and rebuild runes. Moxie accepts him as a friend despite having once reported on Vermil. Noah promises that, after growing stronger, he can repair flawed runes belonging to Moxie and Lee. The professors then plan an off-campus program to prepare Todd, Isabel, and Emily for the survival exam, subject to Neir granting Noah permission to leave Arbitage.

Neir permits the group to leave Arbitage for a month. Noah, Moxie, and Lee take Todd, Isabel, and Emily to the Vibrant Woods, where their first battles expose poor teamwork. Todd and Isabel crowd Emily out of their plans, while Emily's slow but powerful ice attacks need protection and clear firing space. The instructors stage a dangerous gorilla encounter that forces all three students to cooperate: Isabel absorbs its lightning, Todd carries Emily to safety, and Emily kills it with a charged shot. The students acknowledge one another's strengths and begin training as a unit. Moxie then pushes them through exhaustion and energy-control drills before beginning an overnight exercise in which the depleted students must evade her until morning.

The students complete Moxie's pursuit exercise and continue developing better coordination. Revin and his student James are also training in the Vibrant Woods, and Revin becomes interested in Noah's group. A highly intelligent shadow-moving monster begins stalking the travelers and threatens the students to force a confrontation. Noah draws it away and, with Lee waiting in concealment, kills it. Sunder releases powerful runes from the corpse. Lee tears out two of her own runes to absorb a pair of Umbral Body runes, causing severe soul damage and leaving her unconscious. The group carries her out of the woods and redirects its journey toward the Red Barrens. Ordinary medicine cannot restore her soul, but Noah tells Moxie that his earlier failed rune formation healed similar damage. He begins considering how to reproduce that effect safely for Lee.

Lee wakes but remains weakened, while Noah searches for the final components of a coherent rank-three path. In the Red Barrens he studies the local monsters and chooses a natural-disaster theme rather than advancing through a wasteful shortcut. Garina separately demonstrates why rank-seven mages are absent from the Arbalest Empire: she effortlessly defeats a newly advanced rank seven and orders him to leave. She also asks about someone who cannot remain dead. Noah uses runes taken from Dayton's grimoire to create Deafening Thunderstorm and rebuild his water and fire components. With seven rank-two runes prepared, he begins the student-led desert phase. Todd shows exceptional imbuement knowledge by helping the others adapt to sand, but his damaged neck continues to limit his combat role.

Revin deliberately draws dangerous monsters to the students' camp and throws James into the defense, forcing Noah, Moxie, and the four students into separate battles. Everyone survives, but Revin's interest in Noah and the survival exam remains unexplained. Todd develops a brief workaround for his neck injury by maintaining several body imbuements at once. In Grey Barrow, Noah fills his runes and combines them into Natural Disaster, reaching rank three. Contessa arrives with orders showing that Magus Evergreen intends to test Moxie's loyalty through Emily's performance. A supposed Torrin student named Bria attacks Noah and escapes. The attacker is then revealed as Karina, a rank-three Linwick and Vermil's arranged fiancée. Her father refuses to release her from the marriage and keeps her constrained by a rune oath.

Noah tests Natural Disaster, then deliberately dies to recreate the force that once healed his soul. He forms Fragment of Renewal despite resistance from an immense presence. Renewal recognizes that a mortal has taken part of her power and begins searching for him discreetly. The rune successfully starts repairing Lee's soul, though its capacity is limited and its existence must remain secret. Back at Arbitage, Karina reveals herself and seeks Noah's help ending her engagement. She warns that the real Eline and her rank-four trainer Garrick may threaten the students and Moxie. In exchange for possible help with the marriage and the students' blacklist, Karina accepts a temporary protective oath. James joins Todd, Isabel, and Emily's exam team. Revin diverts Garrick's demon detection toward his transplanted demon eye, then wagers that James will pass while Eline fails. Tenfort sends the teams into Snowfield for the final survival exam.

The Snowfield exam requires each student to survive seven days and return with a token from a marked monster. While the students fight repeated attacks, Noah challenges the woman appearing as Magus Evergreen over her treatment of Moxie. Noah's anger releases a rank-five demon from his soul. The demon claims the original Vermil summoned him and that Noah's healing restored his fragmented soul. Noah discovers that their souls share a fold that cannot be severed without destroying both of them, and forces the demon back inside by threatening mutual ruin. The apparent Evergreen proves powerless without her staff and is exposed as a replica rather than the real mage. In Noah's mind, the demon gives his name as Azel and admits to nudging Noah's emotions. Azel identifies the replica as a powerful formation and recommends destroying its staff to erase what it has learned.

Eline steals supplies and tokens from other teams while Isabel's group withstands a prolonged siege without encountering any marked monsters. Noah and Moxie conclude that someone is engineering their failure. Revin deciphers the Evergreen replica's staff and learns that an unknown party hijacked the construct to sabotage Emily's team and distract the real Evergreen from events at Arbitage. The controller briefly speaks through the construct and proposes a meeting without explaining its purpose. Revin destroys and rebuilds the replica, removing its acquired memories, and the group restores the appearance that nothing happened. The saboteur's identity and larger objective remain unknown, while the students still lack the four tokens needed to pass.

Ferdinand of the Great Church of Repose invades the exam grounds and defeats Tenfort, prompting an early end to the test. Garina intervenes under imperial law and shadows Ferdinand, preventing open Church interference while leaving his true mission concealed. Before the students are recalled, Karina attacks Eline and Isabel's team joins the fight. Todd, Isabel, Emily, and James reveal that they reached rank two during their Grey Barrow training. They defeat Eline, take four of her stolen tokens, and all pass. The real Magus Evergreen accepts Emily's performance and grants Moxie two months of leave. Revin invokes his wager but spares Eline, binding her with a shadow chain and taking her as a trainee who may eventually earn freedom. Todd and Isabel plan independent training, Emily will train with James, and Noah, Moxie, and Lee will spend the break together. Azel remains contained inside Noah, while the exam sabotage, Renewal's search, the Church's interest, and the Linwick conflict remain open.
